instruction: Look at task-014_initial.scad. Build a U-shaped fork bracket in a coordinate system centered at x=0,y=0, with z=0 at the bottom. The overall envelope must be 80 x 56 x 52 mm. Make the base 80 x 56 x 8 mm, centered at (0,0,4). Add two side-cheek plates: each plate is 6 mm thick in X, spans y=-18 to y=18 and z=8 to z=52, and is centered at x=-30 or x=30 (their X ranges are -33 to -27 and 27 to 33). Cut one diameter 12 mm cross-pin bore along the X axis at y=0,z=34, using a coaxial cutter spanning x=-34 to x=34 so that it passes completely through both cheeks. Cut four diameter 6 mm mounting holes through only the base from z=0 to z=8, at (x,y)=(-25,-15),(-25,15),(25,-15),(25,15). Add one triangular gusset rib to the positive-Y side of each cheek. Each rib uses the same 6 mm X thickness and X range as its matching cheek and has the YZ cross-section vertices (12,8), (26,8), and (12,44); thus its y=12 vertical edge overlaps the cheek and its z=8 edge overlaps the base. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-014_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output.
